newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-ULLRICH SNATCHES TOUR DE FRANCE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ULLRICH SNATCHES TOUR DE FRANCE LEAD.

text.p: Jan Ullrich took a firm grip of the Tour de France with a magnificent finish on the final climb of the 10th stage in Andorra on Tuesday.

The German left his Telekom team leader and defending champion Bjarne Riis and French challenger Richard Virenque in his wake and surged to victory in the 252.5 km stage from Luchon to Arcalis by one minute eight seconds.
Marco Pantani of Italy was second and Virenque third.
Ullrich gained overall leadership from Cedric Vasseur of France and showed the potential to keep it for the remainder of the race.
